100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On July 29, 1926, the world watched as the League of Nations faced increasing tensions over disputes in the Far East, particularly regarding Japan's activities in China. In Britain, the government struggled to address widespread unemployment, with protests growing in several industrial cities. Meanwhile, in the United States, the stock market continued its upward trajectory, reflecting a post-war economic recovery, despite concerns over inflation.
